verdict.rationale: cubic documents a dedicated cross-repo review feature: you link related repositories so reviews can catch changes that need a matching update elsewhere, such as shared APIs, schemas, docs or release work. Codebase-wide context also supports coherent understanding, since AI chat reads the rest of the codebase, the AI wiki indexes it, and grouped diff descriptions stay beside the code. missing for 10: explicit large-monorepo handling (scale, sharding or module scoping), detail on how cross-repo findings are presented in a review, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo accuracy.
